title: Natty or not (.com): Alpha Destiny (part. 2)
summary: The tail end of NH's rebuttal of a natty-or-not article about Alpha Destiny. He disputes that Alex's physique is impossibly developed or even 'big', rejects hair-loss and bro-science arguments, and concludes that most people can build such a physique naturally.
claims: Intramuscular water matters for size; don't avoid it or chase it by overeating sodium, just eat balanced and get minerals from sea or pink salt
Alex has big traps and lats, but his arms are his weak point, his chest is not exceptional and his legs are not truly big
Alex's good lats come from the lifts he does; he avoids pulls from the floor
Physiques like Alex's or his own are attainable for anyone who sticks to training
No program, his included, is revolutionary; they all apply the same concepts in different ways
A 5'5 160 lb man is not big by any real standard
Zoomed-in, backlit footage making hair look thin is not evidence of PED-induced hair loss
Bro science is just science not yet proven; nucleus overload and weighted stretching were dismissed and are now backed by studies
The vast majority of people can build that kind of mass naturally
